title: Modifications of the Continuous Gromov--Hausdorff Distance
summary: This work studies modifications of the Gromov--Hausdorff distance in which the infimum is taken over pairs of morphisms of a given class $\FF$ --- the class of morphisms of a subcategory of the category of metric spaces (the $\FF$-Gromov--Hausdorff distance). We prove that the $\FF$-distance depends Lipschitz-continuously on the class $\FF$ in the Hausdorff metric on morphisms. As a consequence, for second countable $C^k$-manifolds equipped with a metric compatible with the topology, the smooth distance coincides with the continuous one: $\dGH{C_k} = \dGH{C}$.
